title: No More Permission Guesswork: One Settings Screen | vitalii.no
description:
A missed call or a muted microphone used to look like a bug. In reality the phone itself may have simply denied a permission — camera, microphone, full-screen calls — and there was no single place inside the app to check which one.

A new settings page (web/src/pages/Settings.tsx, 131 lines, React + TypeScript, a reusable Section/Row component pattern) now renders every permission state in one screen. getInfo() in MainActivity.java was extended to report microphone, camera, notification and full-screen-call permissions — the full-screen check runs through Android's NotificationManager.canUseFullScreenIntent() on API 34 and up. A tap opens the exact system settings screen for that permission, and a build hash plus build time, injected at build by vite.config.ts, is shown so support can confirm exactly which build a device is running.

Anyone troubleshooting a call or notification issue can now check the exact permission and build state of a device in one screen, instead of guessing over text.
